facts.value: The LLB in Common and Civil Law programme provides an opportunity to obtain a bachelor’s degree in both Common Law (The Irish/UK legal system) and Civil Law (the system used in most mainland European jurisdictions). Graduates can therefore expect to have a wide variety of options open to them upon graduation.
University of Limerick moot court and appellate court facilities are utilised throughout the programme to develop decision-making and argumentative skills.
The skills developed are transferable and are of great benefit to those who choose to pursue a career outside of law.
UL’s School of Law was awarded Law School of the Year at the prestigious LEAP Irish Law Awards 2025.

University of Limerick can offer students a first-class experience of living and studying in the picturesque city of Besancon while achieving a legal education that opens opportunities throughout Europe and the European Union.
The Bachelor of Laws in Common and Civil Law covers the core subjects required for the Law Society of Ireland Final Examination, Part 1.
The programme is an approved degree for the purpose of Rule 4 of the Education Rules of the Honorable Society of Kings Inns.
Please contact the School of Law, University of Limerick, for current information regarding exemptions.
